CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

DualCLIPLoader.name: DualCLIPLoader
DualCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sdxl: clip-l, clip-g
sd3: clip-l, clip-g / clip-l, t5 / clip-g, t5
flux: clip-l, t5
hidream: at least one of t5 or llama, recommended t5 and llama
hunyuan_image: qwen2.5vl 7b and byt5 small
newbie: gemma-3-4b-it, jina clip v2

image.tooltip: Input image to color correct. Processed in 32-bit float precision.

exposure.tooltip: Exposure adjustment in stops. +1 = double brightness, -1 = half brightness.

contrast.tooltip: Contrast multiplier around mid-gray (0.18 in linear). >1 = more contrast, <1 = less.

brightness.tooltip: Additive brightness offset. Applied last so it works in the final output space.

gamma.tooltip: Gamma correction (power curve). <1 = brighten midtones, >1 = darken. Sign-preserving for HDR.

lift_r.tooltip: Red channel lift (shadow offset). Applied first in the chain.

gain_r.tooltip: Red channel gain (multiplier). Applied after lift, before contrast.

luma_space.tooltip: Luminance weights for saturation. Match your working colorspace.

clamp_output.tooltip: Clamp output to [0,1]. OFF = HDR pass-through (preserves super-whites/negatives).

Float32ColorCorrect.name: Float32ColorCorrect
Float32ColorCorrect.description: Professional 32-bit color correction with exposure, contrast, saturation, gamma, and per-channel lift/gain controls.

GetImageSize.name: GetImageSize
GetImageSize.description: Returns the width, height, and batch size of the image.

GetImageSizeAndCount.name: GetImageSizeAndCount
GetImageSizeAndCount.description:
Returns width, height and batch size of the image,  
and passes it through unchanged.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

color.tooltip: Color as RGB values in range 0-255 or 0.0-1.0, or color name or hex code

ImagePadKJ.name: ImagePadKJ
ImagePadKJ.description: Pad the input image and optionally mask with the specified padding.

ImageStitch.name: ImageStitch
ImageStitch.description:
Stitches image2 to image1 in the specified direction.
If image2 is not provided, returns image1 unchanged.
Optional spacing can be added between images.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.name: LTXAVTextEncoderLoader
LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.description:
Recipes:
ltxav: gemma 3 12B or matching gemma 4 model

latent.tooltip: Video-only latent to condition. Must be a 5D video latent (batch, channels, frames, height, width).

frame_idx.tooltip:
RoPE position of the reference, in pixel frames.
0 aligns the reference with the generated clip. Use for video references.
>0 places the reference at a specific pixel-frame position in the clip.
-1 places the reference outside the generated frame range, while still using it for attention conditioning. Use for single-image references.
For multi-frame references, >0 values are rounded down to 1 mod 8.

latent_downscale_factor.tooltip: For IC-LoRA on small grid. 1 means original size, 2 means half size, 3 means third, etc.

crop.tooltip: Crop mode when resizing. 'center' crops to fit, 'disabled' stretches to fit.

use_tiled_encode.tooltip: Enable tiled VAE encoding for large resolutions/long videos to reduce memory usage.

tile_size.tooltip: Spatial tile size for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

tile_overlap.tooltip: Overlap between tiles for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

use_streaming.tooltip: Off (default): encode the whole clip as one IC-LoRA guide. On: re-encode one fresh guide per LTXVTiledFusionSampler temporal window and write the plan the sampler reads. Set tile_frames on this node and the sampler to the same value (97 for LTX).

tile_frames.tooltip: Window length in pixel frames, used only when use_streaming is on. Snapped to 8n+1. Must match LTXVTiledFusionSampler. Ignored when use_streaming is off.

LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide.name: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide
LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide.description: Adds one or more conditioning frames starting at the specified frame index. Supports both single images and multi-frame videos. The latent_downscale_factor resizes input to a fraction of the target size (1 = original, 2 = half, 3 = third, etc.) for IC-LoRA on small grids. For LTXVTiledFusionSampler temporal windows, turn on use_streaming and set tile_frames to the same 8n+1 value as the sampler (97 for LTX).

LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly.name: LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly
LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly.description: Loads a LoRA model and extracts the latent_downscale_factor from the safetensors metadata.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent
LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning to attach the reference audio tokens to.

LTXVSetAudioRefTokens.name: LTXVSetAudioRefTokens
LTXVSetAudioRefTokens.description: Provides speaker identity context for audio generation by attaching reference audio tokens to the conditioning. The tokens are prepended with negative temporal positions so the model treats them as context rather than generation targets.

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.
